rationale: The ticket replaces EnsureCreated with EF Core migrations applied on host startup. The three contract fixtures encode the three acceptance criteria as observable database outcomes: a missing database is materialised by migrations (applied-migration history non-empty plus a store round-trip), a legacy EnsureCreated database that already holds listing and run rows keeps those rows when migrations are applied, and reapplying migrations to an up-to-date database changes nothing and throws nothing. At base the shared startup surface ApplyMigrations throws NotImplementedException, so all three fail for the missing behaviour rather than for setup.
